'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Marc Nickels DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Marc Nickels]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-3rd-place-ds-marc-nickels-bhbm/ PC list]
